thread.title: Analysts Offer Insights on Consumer Goods Companies: Tesla (TSLA) and Apple (AAPL)

author: Christine Brown
title: Analysts Offer Insights on Consumer Goods Companies: Tesla (TSLA) and Apple (AAPL)
text:
Christine Brown 55 AM EDT SHARE ON:
Analysts have been eager to weigh in on the Consumer Goods sector with new ratings on Tesla ( TSLA ) and Apple ( AAPL ).
Tesla (TSLA)
In a report released today, Rajvindra Gill from Needham maintained a Sell rating on Tesla. $310.12.
Gill commented:
“We maintain an a miss on overall deliveries, specifically Model 3 falling short of consensuses. Entering into an uncertain demand environment, which is subject to consumer spending and macro/ tariff related concerns, we are cautious of holding names that have a significant amount of leverage and lack of cash flow. The combination of several factors including declining volume, lower margins, debt repayment, plus high valuation, puts TSLA in a uniquely vulnerable position, as we see it.”
 Gill is a 5-star analyst with an average return of 10.9% and a 51.9% success rate. Gill covers the Consumer Goods sector, focusing on stocks such as Smart Global Holdings Inc, Everspin Technologies Inc, and Adesto Technologies Corp.
Tesla has an analyst consensus of Hold, with a price target consensus of $337.62, representing an 8.9% upside. In a report released yesterday, Merrill Lynch also maintained a Sell rating on the stock with a $220 price target.
.
Apple (AAPL)
Monness analyst Brian White maintained a Buy rating on Apple today and set a price target of $200 . $157.92, close to its 52-week low of $146.59.
 White is a top 100 analyst with an average return of 17.5% and a 63.9% success rate. White covers the Technology sector, focusing on stocks such as Spotify Technology SA, Salesforce.com, and Alphabet Inc.
Currently, the analyst consensus on Apple is a Moderate Buy with an average price target of $201.57, a 27.6% upside from current levels. In a report issued on December 19, Jefferies also maintained a Buy rating on the stock with a $225 price target.
